transcript: OpenAI just launched Dots, always on agents on ChatGPT, powered by GPT-6 Astra, the world's most intelligent and aligned model. And my Dot was already keeping track of my 1000 person Delhi hackathon while I was travelling, monitoring sponsorship commitments, deadlines, and budgets. While I was flying, it spotted a sponsor workshop clashing with judging, and teams couldn't attend both. But it had access to my meeting notes, emails, docs, and sheets. And my rules were clear: prioritise judging, and ask before spending or sending. Option 1 was to extend the day for 15 lakh rupees, making everyone finish later, or number 2, use a smaller room during build time for 5 lakh rupees, capped at 200 seats, but then the attendees would lose on the coding time. And before I asked, my Dot recommended option 2, protecting judging and budget despite reducing sponsor reach. And then it revised the sponsor's audience commitment, the workshop timetable, and the budget to 10 lakh rupees. And at the end, I landed with the trade-offs analysed, the revised plan ready, and just one decision to make. I approved sending the proposal, and just the sponsor confirmation was pending. What task will you give your Dot? Tell me below in the comments, and I'll see
